description: Step 1 before a Ruzora action that needs a verified buyer: emails the user a 6-digit code and a confirm link. The user reads the code back; confirm_work_email takes it. Sends the email address to Ruzora.

work_email.description: The user's WORK email (personal inboxes are refused)
